data.description: Known for its unique approach to urban living, Al Barari offers a tranquil and green environment, setting it apart from the bustling cityscape.

data.answer: The Al Barari community is designed as an eco-friendly development emphasising green spaces and a harmonious blend with nature. Al Barari spans over 15.3 million sq. ft. and includes a mix of residential villas, apartments, and landscaped gardens. It is situated in Nad Al Sheba, an area in the southeastern part of Dubai. Moreover, the infrastructure improvements ensure that Al Barari remains a top choice for luxury living in a green and sustainable environment.

Al Barari has several residential enclaves catering to different lifestyle preferences, providing various housing options from palatial villas to more compact and modern residences. The villa projects inside the community are as follows:

The Residences: Features four types of eco-friendly villa clusters offering 5 to 6-bedroom spacious homes with many open spaces and breathtaking views.

The Reserve: A beautiful, serene haven with plots between 31,000 and 33,500 sq ft representing exquisite architecture and interior finishes.

The Nest: A collection of 55 4-bedroom villas with floor-to-ceiling glass windows revealing the surrounding themed gardens and waterways. Each villa has a private, landscaped garden and a sparkling infinity pool.

The Nest Revolution: Each residence in The Nest Revolution comprises a private infinity-edge swimming pool, a landscaped garden, an outdoor shower, and a garage for two cars

Chorisia I Homes: The property features sixty 5-bedroom semi-detached villas inspired by one of the most beautiful trees on earth.

Similarly, there are three apartment clusters in the Al Barari community. Nestled amidst the lush greenery and shimmering waterways of Al Barari, these residences are available in configurations, including studios, 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, duplexes, and penthouses.

Ashjar: Immerse yourself in the tranquility of 120 elegant and low-rise villa apartments known as Ashjar. Residents can enjoy facilities like a swimming pool, children's playground, and more.

Seventh Heaven: This development offers 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, exclusive penthouses, duplexes, and garden homes, all meticulously crafted with attention to detail to uphold Al Barari’s legacy of high-end finishes.

The Neighbourhood: Embrace wellness-integrated living at The Neighbourhood. This community features studio, 1, and 2-bedroom residences, each offering access to the full spectrum of leisure and wellness amenities available within Al Barari.

Off-Plan Projects in Al Barari

Here are some of the upcoming projects and expansions in the Al Barari neighborhood:

Les 8: The six-bedroom villas in Les 8 will provide residents with captivating views and a serene environment.

Lunaria: The project houses 40 villas with six bedrooms where residents can enjoy distinctive green living.

Altissima: Featuring 7-bedroom villas, Altissima Al Barari is meticulously crafted to deliver an unparalleled fusion of sophistication and environmental mindfulness.

Ixora: The 82 exquisite 4-bedroom homes will offer distinctive green living, exceptional architecture, and captivating views amid a relaxed and elegant atmosphere.

Chorisia II: The project, currently under construction, will provide 57 magnificent villas with stunning views of lagoons and architecturally inspired interiors set in a calm and fashionable setting.

Fountain Drive: Twelve opulent plots with floor plans beginning at 30,000 square feet. enormous in size, ideal in its setting, and exquisite in the views.

Renting A Property in Al Barari

Available for rent are apartments ranging from 1 to 3 bedrooms in Al Barari. The annual rents for 1-bedroom apartments can fluctuate between AED 240,000 and AED 290,000. Meanwhile, the rental range for 2-bedroom apartments in Al Barari spans from AED 260,000 to AED 550,000 per annum. For those seeking 3-bedroom apartments, the rental costs in Al Barari range from AED 485,000 to AED 950,000 per year.

Penthouses for rent in Al Barari are limited, with the rental rate for a 2-bedroom penthouse set at AED 450,000 per annum.
As for villas available for rent, 4-bedroom villas in Al Barari are priced at AED 4 million annually. For 5-bedroom villas, the rent ranges from AED 850,000 to AED 4 million per year.
For those searching for more spacious rental options, 6-bedroom villas in Al Barari come with a rental price ranging from AED 1.1 million to AED 1.6 million per annum. If you are interested in renting 8+ bedroom villas in Al Barari, the rental cost is AED 1.3 million per year.

Buying A Property in Al Barari

There are many properties available for sale in Al Barari. For those interested in studios, prices range from AED 619,000 to AED 1.47 million. Prospective buyers seeking 1-bedroom apartments in Al Barari can expect to invest between AED 924,000 and AED 3.5 million.

For 2-bedroom apartments in Al Barari, sale prices fall from AED 1.6 million to AED 6.1 million. Larger units, such as 3-bedroom apartments, are priced between AED 6.7 million and AED 16 million. If you are considering 4-bedroom flats, the sale prices in Al Barari vary from AED 8.5 million to AED 34 million. You can find various apartments for sale in Ashjar.

Al Barari also offers a limited number of 2-bedroom penthouses for sale, with the price for a 2-bedroom penthouse set at AED 7.9 million. Al Barari Residences feature villas ranging from 4 to 8+ bedrooms. The sale price for a 4-bedroom villa is between AED 5.5 million and AED 36.5 million, with living spaces ranging from 6,000 sq. ft. to 10,000 sq. ft. Explore luxury villas for sale in Ixora and other villa communities within Al Barari.

Similarly, a 5-bedroom villa for sale in Al Barari ranges from AED 9.8 million to AED 95 million, while 6-bedroom villas are offered for AED 19 million to AED 43 million. The pricing of villas is determined by the number of bedrooms and the coverage area. Luxurious 7-bedroom houses for sale in Al Barari cost approximately AED 19 million to AED 23.5 million. The sale price for an 8+ bedroom villa in Al Barari is AED 11.8 million.

Additionally, Al Barari Residences feature 4 and 5-bedroom townhouses. The sale price for 4-bedroom houses ranges from AED 5.5 million to AED 9 million, while a 5-bedroom townhouse in Al Barari is available for AED 13 million.

more_info.question: What's Life Like in Al Barari?

data.answer:
One of the benefits of living in Al Barari is access to high-end amenities, including gourmet restaurants, a wellness center, a spa, and fitness facilities. Al Barari is renowned for its extensive green spaces and botanical gardens. The community is designed to provide residents with a serene and natural environment, contrasting with Dubai's urban landscape.

The community features upscale and spacious residences, including villas, apartments, and penthouses. These properties are known for their contemporary designs, high-end finishes, and integration with the surrounding greenery.

Public Transportation Near Al Barari

Positioned across from Global Village and the City of Arabia, the available villas and apartments for sale in Al Barari are conveniently located just off the main Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) near Nad Al Sheba, Dubai.

The nearest metro station is Rashidiya Metro Station, approximately 20 minutes away, while the closest bus stop to the neighborhood is Global Village Station. Bus routes 102, 103, 104, and 106 operate from this stop. Alternatively, a more distant option is in Al Reem, Arabian Ranches, where the J02 bus stops and provides connectivity to the Mall of the Emirates station.

Supermarkets Near Al Barari

In Al Barari, residents enjoy convenient access to a variety of supermarkets, including Waitrose and F Mart. The neighboring community of Majan hosts Quick Supermarket, Goodies Supermarket, and Burj Safa Supermarket. Additionally, there are ZOOM mini-mart and AllDay Mini Mart options. A Spinneys supermarket is situated in The Villa community, approximately 22 minutes from Al Barari. Thomson Supermarket & Department Store and West Zone Supermarket in Dubailand are also available within almost the same distance.

Shopping Malls in Al Barari

A short distance away in Dubai Silicon Oasis, the Cedre Shopping Centre is easily accessible. There are other nearby shopping destinations, such as City Centre Me’aisem in Dubai Production City and My City Centre Al Barsha. These malls provide a diverse range of retail outlets, dining establishments, and various amenities.

Schools and Nurseries in Al Barari

The closest choices for early education include FalconCity Nursery in Falcon City of Wonders and Kids Zone Nursery in the neighboring community of The Villa.

Within Al Barari, Dunecrest American School provides excellent education following the American curriculum, offering pre-kindergarten to Grade 12 classes. Additionally, it provides the option of the International Baccalaureate (IB) curriculum for Grade 11 and 12. Directly opposite the community, GEMS Heritage Indian School delivers the Indian CBSE curriculum from pre-kindergarten to Grade 10.

Several options are available for those seeking higher education and specialized academic institutions. On the eastern side of the community, Dubai International Academic City (DIAC) houses numerous reputable universities, including Curtin University Dubai, Al Ghurair University, Emirates Aviation University, and Heriot-Watt University Dubai.

Churches, Temples And Mosques in Al Barari

Within Al Barari, there is a dedicated community mosque. For more options, residents can explore the neighboring communities of Living Legends and Falcon City of Wonders. Al Wasl Mosque in Liwan is also conveniently reachable, just a 12-minute drive from Barari.

As for a nearby church, The Gatekeepers Weekday Warehouse in the Al Quoz area to the north serves the community. Hindu temples are predominantly situated in Bur Dubai, close to the museum. Both the Shiva and Krishna temples can be reached within a 30-minute drive. Additionally, in this area, you'll find the Sikh Gurudwara. Another Sikh place of worship, Gurunanak Darbar in Jebel Ali, is approximately 35 minutes away.

Clinics And Hospitals in Al Barari

Numerous clinics and hospitals are conveniently situated near Al Barari. In Majan, you can access Dr. Kamkar Medical & Physiotherapy Center, while Dubai London Clinic is located in The Villa community. Within the Dubai Silicon Oasis neighborhood, which is approximately 14 minutes away, you'll find Medicure Centre, Symbiosis Medical Centre, and Aster Clinic.

Al Barari Location And Nearby Areas

Al Barari is centrally located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, offering residents easy access to various amenities and attractions. Dubai Silicon Oasis, known for its focus on technology and innovation, is just a short distance from Al Barari. This vibrant technology park features a mix of residential and commercial developments, contributing to the dynamic character of the surrounding areas.

In the eastern direction of Al Barari lies Dubai International Academic City (DIAC), a prominent education hub housing several universities and academic institutions. This strategic location offers convenient access to higher education and specialized academia for residents.

Additionally, The Villa community and Falcon City of Wonders are nearby areas that contribute to the rich tapestry of attractions surrounding Al Barari.

more_info.question: Things To Do in Al Barari

data.answer:
In Al Barari, residents and visitors can indulge in a range of activities amidst the lush greenery and luxury surroundings. Enjoy a peaceful day exploring the breathtaking Dubai Miracle Garden nearby, boasting millions of vibrant flowers. For motorsports enthusiasts, the Dubai Autodrome offers thrilling racing experiences.

Stroll through the community's landscaped gardens or partake in outdoor activities in the serene surroundings. For those seeking cultural experiences, Al Barari's proximity to attractions like IMG Worlds of Adventure and Global Village provides exciting entertainment options. Additionally, residents can savor diverse culinary delights at the local and neighboring restaurants, creating a perfect blend of nature, luxury, and recreational pursuits.

Restaurants Near Al Barari Dubai

Residents can enjoy dining at the community's signature restaurant, The Farm. The restaurant is set within the lush greenery, providing a unique and scenic culinary experience. Al Barari also has plans for additional retail and dining options to enhance the overall lifestyle within the community.

Regarding dining options, visitors and residents of Barari have diverse choices, ranging from casual eateries to upscale restaurants. Al Barari and its vicinity offer a culinary experience that spans traditional Arab cuisine, continental dishes, and even special gourmet treats, ensuring that the community caters to various tastes.

Near Al Barari, some nearby dining establishments include Lowe, Purple Fork, Chin Chin, Kabab Rolls, Wings & more. Towards the eastern side, close to Academic City, you can explore places like Shakespeare & Co, Taco Barrio, Ying & Yang Restaurant, Circle Café, Tomato & Basilico Restaurant, Pizza Hut, and Subway. For those in Al Barari, numerous cafes, including Starbucks, Costa Coffee, Caffé Nero, and Filli Café, offer many options to enjoy coffee or a casual meal.

Beaches Near Al Barari

Getting to the renowned beaches in Dubai is easily achievable with the proximity of some beach destinations near Al Barari. Whether planning a family day out or a beach picnic, places like Marina Beach and Jumeirah Public Beach are conveniently situated just a 25 to 30-minute drive away. For those seeking a more adventurous experience with water sports events, Kite Beach and Umm Suqeim Beach are excellent options. These beaches offer thrilling water sports activities that cater to the enjoyment of families, young couples, and individuals alike.

Hotels Near Al Barari

There are various hotels located near Al Barari. The best nearby options include the Park Inn by Radisson Dubai Motor City. Located in Motor City, this hotel is near Al Barari and offers modern amenities. Aparthotel Adagio Dubai Al Barsha is situated in Al Barsha. This hotel is close to Al Barari and provides apartment-style accommodations.

Meliá Desert Palm Dubai is also a nearby option known for its serene environment and elegant facilities. Premier Inn Dubai Silicon Oasis is in the Dubai Silicon Oasis neighborhood near Al Barari.

Location and Attractions in Al Barari

Al Barari is near the renowned Dubai Miracle Garden, home to over 250 million exotic flowers and 50 million plant species. The Dubai Autodrome is situated in the same area, having hosted prestigious events like the Renault V6 Eurocup Season, FIA GT Championship, Dubai 24 Hour, European Touring Car Championship, and various endurance races.

Additionally, the Dubai Polo Equestrian Club is just a short distance away, offering horseback riding and polo opportunities. IMG Worlds of Adventure takes the spotlight among the notable attractions near the community. This thrilling theme park boasts an array of attractions, including roller coasters, themed restaurants, and souvenir shops, ensuring an enjoyable experience for adults and children.

Also in the vicinity, Global Village is a distinctive theme park with international pavilions representing various regions worldwide. Global Village offers a diverse range of rides, games, and food stalls, providing a unique and entertaining experience.

Outdoor Activities and Fitness Facilities

The community emphasizes health and wellness, offering fitness facilities, spa services, and recreational spaces. Residents can access fitness centers, yoga studios, and outdoor sports facilities, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle.

While Al Barari provides a serene environment with green spaces, it may have fewer social amenities such as community events, public gathering spaces, and a vibrant social scene than more urbanized areas.

Moreover, given the limited public transportation options, residents may need to rely more on private transportation, which might be a concern for those who prefer public transit.

Where is Al Barari located in Dubai?

Al Barari is centrally located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It is situated near the Dubai Miracle Garden and the Dubai Autodrome.

Are there healthcare facilities in Al Barari?

As Al Barari does not have healthcare facilities, clinics and hospitals in nearby areas are the best options for residents. These communities include Majan and Dubai Silicon Oasis.

What dining options are available in and around Al Barari?

Various dining options range from casual eateries to high-end restaurants in Al Barari and nearby areas like Al Quoz, Dubai Silicon Oasis, and Academic City.

What types of properties are available in Al Barari?

Al Barari offers a variety of residences, including villas, apartments, and penthouses, focusing on luxury and green living.

How far is Al Barari from Dubai International Airport?

Al Barari is approximately 20-25 minutes by car from Dubai International Airport.

How is transportation in Al Barari?

Transportation in Al Barari primarily relies on private cars and taxis, with easy access to major highways; public transportation options are limited.

What recreational activities are available in Al Barari?

Recreational activities in Al Barari include themed gardens, walking trails, fitness centers, a spa, gourmet restaurants, and community events.

data.content:
Al Barari is a luxurious residential community in the heart of Dubai. Renowned for its lush greenery and commitment to sustainability, the district is home to an extensive botanical garden, themed landscaped parks, and over 500 plant species.

It features high-end and spacious villas and apartments designed with contemporary and traditional architecture. These properties, developed by Al Barari Developers, offer eco-friendly amenities and uninterrupted views.

The district is strategically located with easy access to key areas of Dubai, like Arabian Ranches, Dubai Silicon Oasis, and Motor City. Also, it is connected to major highways, business districts, and leisure destinations.

nodes.title: The Cape
nodes.about:
The Cape at Al Barari features three elegant towers rising across eight floors, offering a refined collection of 1, 2, 3 and 4-bedroom apartments. Designed with clean architecture, natural finishes, and generous layouts, the residences create a calm living environment surrounded by greenery and open views.

The Cape by Al Barari blends resort-style amenities with everyday comfort, including landscaped courtyards, wellness spaces, and leisure facilities. With a 5% down payment and limited availability within Al Barari, the development offers strong capital appreciation potential in one of Dubai’s most well-established luxury communities.

nodes.title: The Lofts
nodes.about:
The Lofts Zaya project is a luxury residential development situated in Dubai’s greenest and most serene neighborhood, Al Barari. Designed for those seeking a balance between modern city life and natural beauty, The Lofts by Zaya features 70 luxury residences with a choice of 1-bedroom apartments and signature lofts designed for open-plan living.

Each unit is crafted with minimalist interiors, premium materials, and panoramic windows that invite natural light and tranquil views. These Lofts apartments by Zaya are part of the larger Seventh Heaven complex, offering residents both privacy and access to world-class lifestyle facilities.

nodes.title: Altissima
nodes.about:
Discover the pinnacle of eco-friendly luxury at Altissima Al Barari, a jewel in Dubai's crown. Inspired by the enchanting 'tree of heaven', this green paradise is the last chapter in the Al Barari saga, setting a new standard in sustainable living. 

Each of the magical 7-bedroom villas at Altissima Al Barari has been meticulously designed to offer an unrivaled blend of elegance and environmental consciousness. As a resident, you'll enjoy a life of unparalleled luxury and wellness, surrounded by lush landscapes and tranquil waterways. Altissima Al Barari is not just a place to stay; it's a lifestyle. Crafted for individuals seeking a comprehensive and sustainable lifestyle, this botanical sanctuary effortlessly harmonizes the elements of nature with opulent living. It serves as a haven where you can play, work, dine and shop.

Residents can maintain their active lifestyle at Altissima, thanks to the four Padel Courts, a Bowling Alley, Billiards, and Table Tennis in the complex. They can enjoy some pampering at the world-class retreat featuring massage rooms, saunas, ice baths, pools, hammams, full-service hair, and much more. Alternatively, sip a delicious cup of coffee at the cozy Café.

This verdant retreat in the heart of Dubai offers everything from shopping and dining to leisure and work opportunities, all within an eco-conscious and wellness-enhancing environment. Al Barari, meaning 'wilderness' in Arabic, is a trailblazer in integrated luxury and sustainable development.
